newsitem.title: USA: Medar places $7 million in debentures.
newsitem.headline: Medar places $7 million in debentures.

text.p: Medar Inc said it has privately placed $7 million of subordinated debentures that bear interest at 12.95 perceent with maturites of up to eight years.
Purchasers include Maxco Inc, which owns 21 percent of Medar.
Additionally, Medar said the noteholders received warrants for the purchase of 1.4 million Medar common shares at $6.86 each. Medar stock closed up 1/4 at 5-1/2 on Tuesday.
The agreement provides for limitations on common shareholder dilution in the first year in the event of significant market price increases in Medar stock.
As a part of the transaction, Maxco agreed to purchase 150,000 newly issued and unregistered shares of Medar common stock at $5 per share.
The proceeds from the sale of the debentures and the common stock are expected to be used to reduce certain bank borrowings and for working capital purposes, Medar said.
